correctness.rationale: Uniform priorities give uniform choice of an allowed residual edge: after each acceptance the relative order of the remaining feasible edges is still uniform. For even k≥4 the deletion graph cannot contain a clique on the residual k-set, so the only possible nonzero terminal vacancy is a forbidden pair. For a tagged forbidden pair the avoidance ratio at size k is [binom(k-2,2)-r]/[binom(k,2)-1-a-r], with r≤k and a≤2. Relative to (k-3)/(k+1) the difference is O(k^-2): the change from r is multiplied by the O(k) difference of the two baseline counts, and the change from a is O(k²), against a denominator of order k⁴. The product to an even K gives (K²-1)/(N²-1) with relative O(1/K). The analogous comparison with binom(k-t,2)/binom(k,2) for any t≤4 marked vertices gives O((K/N)^t). Given tagged survival, the union bound over at most two adjacent and at most N disjoint other forbidden edges is O(K/N+K²/N). From any such exceptional residual state the tagged pair's final-survival probability is O(K^-2), by its survival to a fixed even stage. If no other forbidden edge remains it is exactly 3/(K²-1). Combining gives relative O(1/K+K²/N) for the event that the last pair is the tag. Choosing even K of order N^(1/3) and summing disjoint last-pair events proves the uniform error, also for m=1. The zero-deletion case, vacancy expectation, matching existence by Dirac and the stated limits follow. The frozen verification notes and script were inspected, not run. The finite examples are diagnostic, not required for this proof; the script's header gives a stale filename, whereas VERIFICATION.md correctly identifies verify.py.

value.rationale: The failure probability of a greedy matching on a graph that admits a perfect matching is a natural performance observable. Uniformity from one removed edge up to a linear number, including both regular and nonregular deletions, resolves whether geometry can change the leading constant. This is more than an evaluation of the symmetric matching or cycle. The frozen error rate is not credited as optimal.
